# Yomi

> Yomi is an AI productivity assistant you talk to on Telegram with text, voice notes, or
> photos. It connects to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Classroom, Google Tasks,
> Google Meet, GitHub, Slack, Notion, and Linear, and asks for approval before it changes
> anything.

Yomi reads data only to answer the question you just asked and never stores it afterward.
The web dashboard at [getyomi.in](https://getyomi.in) is account management (linking,
schedules, memory, billing) — Telegram is the only chat surface.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://getyomi.in/docs): connectors, voice, memory, and credits
- [Support](https://getyomi.in/support): contact and help
- [Privacy Policy](https://getyomi.in/privacy): data handling, retention, and Google API Services User Data Policy compliance
- [Terms of Service](https://getyomi.in/terms): terms of use
